description: Disconnect a custom domain from a managed community. Requires confirm set to DISCONNECT. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation for this write. Pass the exact literal this tool requires (for example DELETE) only after the user approves the action.

customDomainId.description: Custom domain ID, from the custom domain tools for this business.

name: disconnect_custom_domain
title: Disconnect Custom Domain
